question: What current iOS availability statement should /platforms/ios publish for users looking for the official app?
rationale: The issue is a docs gap, but the correct wording depends on live App Store/TestFlight release status that changed since the linked PR was opened and should be confirmed by an iOS release owner.

options.title: Refresh The Linked Docs PR
options.body: Confirm the official App Store status and update the linked PR to include the official listing or current access path plus a warning about similarly named third-party apps.

options.title: Keep Preview-Only Wording
options.body: If the App Store listing is not considered a supported public install path, land wording that explicitly says so and explains the supported request or source-build path.

options.title: Close The Stale PR And Refile
options.body: If the linked branch is too stale against current release facts, close it and track a fresh narrow docs fix for the current App Store/TestFlight/source-build state.

recommendation.title: Refresh The Linked Docs PR
recommendation.body: Confirm the official App Store status and update the linked PR to include the official listing or current access path plus a warning about similarly named third-party apps.

likelyOwner.reason: ngutman has the strongest iOS distribution and App Store release history among the routed owners.
